question: Rangaswami Cup is associated with which game ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rangaswamy Cup:-**

 
 
• **The Rangaswamy Cup is a national hockey competition held in India. **
 
• The competition began in 1928 and was originally known as the Inter-Provincial Tournament.
 
• Its purpose was to select players for the national team for the Olympics.
 
• The Rangaswamy Cup is India's most prestigious hockey tournament.
 
• The competition is held every year and is participated by teams from all states and union territories of India.
